host_approval_evidence.rule: Host approval permits host transport only. It never becomes AuthorizationResult or Blu authorization automatically.

authorization_evidence_transport.sign_in_rule: A user signed into ChatGPT or Codex is not usable Blu authorization evidence unless the supported adapter interface exposes independently verifiable identity, role, or credential evidence for the required policy scope.

sur011_boundary: BC-020 reports correlation evidence but does not decide what happens when an unrelated turn arrives during a pending protected authorization interaction. Protected attempt values, retry/lockout/backoff, cancellation/reset, and new-request-after-exhaustion policy remain SUR-011.
